d: Anant Singh Daughter Wedding :mokama vidhayak anant sinh ki beti shivangi sinh (Shivangi Singh Wedding) ki shadi ki taiyariyon men char lakh se adhik logon ke khane ki vyavastha men kaee jilon se halvaee pahunch gae hain. ganv men jahan bhi tent aur pandal lage hain, sabhi jagah mehmanon ke svagat men mithaee taiyar karne ke lie darjanon mitti ke chulhon par dudh ubale ja rahe hain. bare bare karahon men kaee kism ke lal, gulabjamun aur spanj rasgulle net se dhankkar rakhe gae hain. sabhi mithaiyan shuddh desi ghi men taiyar ki ja rahi hain. uttarapradesh, bangal aur bihar ke kaee jilon ke…
